story.title: The dodo bird had a secret sensory world scientists are only now discovering
story.reason: Overturns old misconceptions about the dodo, revealing a clever and sensory-rich creature that charms the imagination.
story.title_ja: ドードー鳥の知られざる感覚の世界：旧来のイメージを覆す発見
story.reason_ja: おっとりしたイメージだったドードー鳥が、実は豊かな感覚を持つ賢い鳥だったことが分かり、昔の誤解を解く微笑ましいニュースです。
story.jp_copy: これまでのイメージとは異なり、絶滅したドードー鳥が実は豊かな感覚世界と知性を持っていたことが最新の研究で判明しました。長年の誤解が解け、ドードー鳥の賢く魅力的な素顔が明らかになる、知的好奇心に満ちた嬉しい発見です。
story.en_copy: Long misunderstood, the dodo bird is now being revealed as a clever creature with a rich sensory world. Scientists are overturning old misconceptions, giving us a fresh and charming perspective on a smart bird whose true nature is finally being appreciated.
story.duck_jp: ドードー鳥は実はとっても賢かったんですね！誤解が解けて良かった！
story.duck_en: The dodo was clever all along! Glad history is setting the record straight.
story.x_jp: 鈍感だと思われていたドードー鳥の秘密が解明！実は豊かな感覚と知性を持った賢い鳥だったことが分かりました。
story.x_en: New discoveries show the dodo bird was actually clever and sensory-rich, overturning old misconceptions!

concepts.title_ja: 博物館での発見のひらめき
concepts.concept_ja: 明るく洗練された自然史研究室で、アヒル記者がドードー鳥のモデルと触れ合い、そのすぐれた感覚機能の秘密に感嘆する知的好奇心あふれるシーン。
concepts.concept_en: In a bright modern natural history studio, the yellow duck reporter stands beside a friendly dodo bird figure, marveling at the glowing visual cues that highlight its acute sensory abilities.
concepts.composition_ja: 画面左側にアヒル記者、右側に表情豊かなドードー鳥のモデルを配置。柔らかな自然光が差し込む清潔感のある空間でのミディアムショット。
concepts.composition_en: A medium horizontal shot with the yellow duck mascot on the left curiously examining a charming dodo bird model on the right, set in a clean studio bathed in soft daylight.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: A clean modern editorial hero image featuring a friendly yellow duck mascot with an orange beak, large glossy dark eyes, and a small feather tuft. The duck stands in a bright, minimalist natural history museum studio alongside a friendly, soft-textured dodo bird sculpture. Soft pastel lighting highlights colorful aromatic flower blossoms near the dodo bird's beak, visualizing its keen sense of smell. Clean studio backdrop, warm pastel color palette, modern 3D editorial graphic style, visually clear, no embedded text, no watermark.
concepts.alt_ja: 自然史スタジオで、ドードー鳥の豊かな感覚世界を興味深く観察するアヒル記者
concepts.alt_en: The Daily Duck mascot observing a friendly dodo bird model in a bright museum studio setting

concepts.title_ja: 太陽の島での感覚アドベンチャー
concepts.title_en: Sensory Adventure in the Island Forest
concepts.concept_ja: 光があふれる豊かな熱帯の森で、アヒル記者がドードー鳥と一緒に歩きながら、ドードー鳥が花々の香りや森の音を楽しむ賢く魅力的な姿を見守る光景。
concepts.concept_en: In a vibrant, sun-dappled tropical forest, the yellow duck mascot explores alongside a gentle dodo bird who keenly interacts with fragrant blossoms and natural sounds.
concepts.composition_ja: 画面中央でアヒル記者とドードー鳥が並んで歩く横長の構図。背景には木漏れ日と豊かな熱帯の植物が美しく広がります。
concepts.composition_en: A wide horizontal landscape shot showing the yellow duck walking side by side with an adorable dodo bird through a sunny tropical forest filled with soft bokeh lights and tropical foliage.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: A vibrant and charming editorial illustration. The yellow duck mascot with an orange beak, large glossy dark eyes, and a small feather tuft walks side by side with a friendly, intelligent dodo bird through a lush, sunlit tropical forest. The dodo bird leans down happily to smell a bright, glowing tropical flower, demonstrating its refined sensory awareness. Warm sunlight filtering through green leaves, joyful atmosphere, clean modern visual editorial style, smooth 3D rendering, no text, no watermark.
concepts.alt_ja: 木漏れ日が差し込む南国の森で、ドードー鳥とともに自然の感覚を楽しむアヒル記者
concepts.alt_en: The yellow duck mascot walking alongside a dodo bird exploring sensory flowers in a sunlit forest

concepts.title_ja: 知性を明かすギャラリーポートレート
concepts.concept_ja: 洗練されたモダンギャラリーで、ドードー鳥の優れた知性と五感を象徴する美しい音波・香りの幾何学アートパネルを、アヒル記者が笑顔で見上げるスタイリッシュな構図。
concepts.concept_en: In a minimalist modern gallery space, the yellow duck reporter presents a luminous art panel showcasing a charming dodo bird surrounded by elegant, colorful sensory ripple motifs.
concepts.composition_ja: 右側に誇らしげに微笑むアヒル記者、中央奥にライトアップされたドードー鳥の美しいイラストパネルを配置したアイレベルの構図。
concepts.composition_en: An eye-level editorial image with the yellow duck mascot on the right looking up happily at a backlit graphic artwork displaying a clever dodo bird with colorful sensory waves.
concepts.generation_prompt_en: A sleek and elegant visual hero illustration. On the right, the iconic friendly yellow duck mascot with an orange beak and glossy dark eyes smiles warmly as it looks up at a large glowing display board. On the display board is a stylish portrait of a clever dodo bird, surrounded by smooth, colorful abstract ripple patterns representing smell and sound perception. Minimalist gallery environment, warm studio lighting, clean editorial design style, visually sharp, no text, no logo, no watermark.
concepts.alt_ja: モダンなギャラリーで、ドードー鳥の知性と感覚を表現したアートパネルを見上げるアヒル記者
concepts.alt_en: The yellow duck mascot presenting an artistic backlit display of a clever dodo bird in a modern gallery
